stories.title: £10,600 raised at Caerwys classic car show for air ambulance and hospice
stories.summary: A classic car show in Caerwys has raised £10,600 for Wales Air Ambulance and St Kentigern Hospice. The two charities each received £5,300 from this year’s event. stories.title: Public tip-off leads to uninsured driver’s car being seized in Flint
stories.summary: A car has been seized in Flint after a tip-off from a member of the public led police to an uninsured driver. stories.title: Mold man banned from every Tesco and Boots in the country for five years
stories.summary: A Mold man has been banned from every Tesco and Boots store in the country for five years after admitting shoplifting at both stores in the town. stories.title: North Wales Police unit doubles national average for catching online predators
stories.summary: A specialist North Wales Police team has more than doubled the national average for positive outcomes in tackling online child abuse. The Online Child Abuse Investigation Team achieved a 60 per cent positive outcome rate for investigations into the sexual exploitation of children online.
